name: Wyvern, Night (3pp)
source: Pathfinder 4: Fortress of the Stone Giants
book: Pathfinder 4: Fortress of the Stone Giants

facets.bk: Pathfinder 4: Fortress of the Stone Giants

body:
A night wyvern is a wyvern with the nocturnal [3pp] creature template.

Night Wyvern
CR 7

XP 3,200
N Large nocturnal Dragon
Init +7; Senses darkvision 60 ft., low-light vision, scent; Perception +16

DEFENSE

AC 21, touch 12, flat-footed 18 (+3 Dex, +9 natural, -1 size)
hp 80 (7d12+35)
Fort +10, Ref +8, Will +7
Immune sleep, paralysis
Weaknesses Light Sensitivity

OFFENSE

Speed 20 ft., fly 60 ft. (poor)
Melee sting +13 (1d6+6 plus Poison), bite +12 (3d6+6 plus Grab), 2 wings +7 (1d6+3)
Space 10 ft.; Reach 5 ft.
Special Attacks Rake (2 talons +12,1d6+6)

STATISTICS

Str 23, Dex 16, Con 19, Int 7, Wis 14, Cha 7
Base Atk +7; CMB +14 (+18 on grapple); CMD 27
Feats Flyby Attack, Improved Initiative, Improved Natural Attack (bite), Weapon Focus (sting)
Skills Fly +11, Perception +16 (+12 in bright light), Sense Motive +12, Stealth +13; Racial Modifiers +4 Perception (-4 in bright light), +4 Stealth
Languages Draconic

SPECIAL ABILITIES

Poison (Ex)

Sting – injury; save Fort DC 19, frequency 1/round for six rounds; effect 1d4 Constitution; cure 2 consecutive saves. The save DC is Constitution-based.
